newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan, G7 trying to avoid big forex moves -- Kubo.
newsitem.headline: Japan, G7 trying to avoid big forex moves -- Kubo.

text.p: Japanese Finance Minister Wataru Kubo said on Thursday that Japan, along with the Group of Seven (G7) nations, is trying to avoid major fluctuations in the foreign exchange market.

Kubo was asked to comment on an article in the Nikkei Financial Daily newspaper which quoted Eisuke Sakakibara, director-general of the Finance Ministry's International Finance Bureau, as saying that the dollar's correction of last year's sharp slide against the yen was about to finish.
"The foreign exchange market is moving in line with economic fundamentals," Kubo replied.
Sakakibara declined to comment when asked about the article on Thursday morning.
Kubo said G7 nations are in close contact and cooperating closely in an effort to avoid sharp currency fluctuations.
